info.name: Patsnap Open Platform AI Translation Enterprise Tech Analysis API

items.docs: This interface provides information on the number of industry-university-research cooperation instances for enterprises, the number of applicants for industry-university-research cooperation, and the patent counts of the top 10 industry-university-research cooperation applicants
This interface provides the patent query of the enterprise's core patent (Top 10 patent value).
